fieldData.full-article-text:
Yes, Radix Tokens Jersey Limited intends to operate validator nodes at genesis as a network bootstrapping function, and on an ongoing basis with the goal of providing support to network reliability and security while not attempting to compete with validator nodes run by the community. Our staking policies (described below) will aim to ensure that only a minimum number of nodes are likely to be part of the validator set – and with time there may no longer be benefit in us running them at all.

Click here for more info.
